h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jorhat

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jorhat

items.pText: Jorhat is a tea town in Upper Assam, home to tea research and the gateway to Majuli island on the Brahmaputra. It is green, humid and wet for much of the year. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, tea estates and colonies here at our factory in Vasai, about 2,320 km away, and sends it to Assam by road.

In weather this damp, the commonest everyday hazard on a playground is a slippery surface. Shady corners stay wet long after rain, and moss and algae grow on paving, steps and the edges of rubber flooring. Equipment under heavy tree cover gets the worst of it. When we plan your layout, we look at where the sun reaches the site, so the play area can dry out between showers. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts cope well with the damp, but the ground around them needs care.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Place the play area where it gets some direct sun each day, and trim branches that keep it in permanent shade. Sweep fallen leaves often, since a wet layer of leaves holds moisture and feeds moss. Scrub any green film off steps and rubber flooring with water and a stiff brush. Use only a soft cloth on plastic parts and slides. Check that water drains away from the base after every heavy shower.

items.q: Why does playground equipment get slippery in Jorhat?
items.a: Constant damp and shade let moss and algae grow on surfaces. Give the play area some sun, sweep leaves often and scrub any green film off the flooring and steps.

items.q: Can tea estates order playground equipment from you?
items.a: Yes. Tea estates, schools and colonies in and around Jorhat can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through a dealer in the Northeast or our own team. Our galvanised and roto-moulded materials suit the wet climate of the estates.

items.q: How should we clean plastic slides and decks?
items.a: Rinse them with water and wipe with a soft cloth. Avoid harsh scrubbing pads and strong chemicals, which can scratch the surface and make it hold dirt more easily.
